steps.title: Look at the words after for and after since . What is the difference?
options: for is for the past, since is for the present
for comes before a length of time; since comes before the point it started
for is formal and since is informal
there is no difference — you can use either one
steps.answer: for comes before a length of time; since comes before the point it started

steps.title: Отметь, чему научился
items: ✓ say how long something has been true — I’ve worked here for five years
✓ choose between for and since — for + a length, since + a starting point
✓ ask How long have you…? and give a short answer
✓ name jobs, workplaces and the people you work with — client, customer, staff, open-plan office
✓ tell what is still true from what is over recycled — I’ve worked / I worked / I used to work
